scope: Six base skills available at spawn. Tooltip values follow patch 3.1.3. No upgrade nodes, item affixes or paragon. Weapon damage 32, animation timing, radii and the Whirlwind 0.5 s hit interval are local combat tuning; tick timing is not claimed as a verified D4 simulation.

lunging_strike.verification: Current database tooltip cross-check; hit timing, range and rank scaling remain unverified.

whirlwind.verification: 15 Fury/s and 72% tooltip coefficient. 0.5 second damage interval is explicit project tuning, not verified D4 frame data.

rallying_cry.verification: Base skill reference; Booming, Fury Gain and The World are separate current-version modifiers.

war_cry.verification: Base tooltip 4 seconds; 6 seconds belongs to the Duration Increase upgrade. No upgrades selected.

leap.verification: Base skill tooltip: generate 15 Fury, 55% damage, Slow 70% for 3 seconds; 17 second cooldown.

wrath_of_the_berserker.verification: Base tooltip: Berserking and Unstoppable for 10 seconds, knock back nearby enemies; 90 second cooldown.
